input.description: The screen displays a map of a house with labeled rooms: Family Room, Kitchen, Dining Room, Living Room, and Foyer. The map is outlined in purple, and there is a small icon representing a robot vacuum in the Dining Room. At the top, it shows the time as 3:00 with a muted notification icon. The name "Abby" is displayed with a dropdown arrow next to it. A status bar indicates "Clean in progress" with a battery icon showing 25% charge. At the bottom, there are three buttons: "Go to Dock" in red, "Find Robot" in purple, and "Pause" in purple.
all_user_responses: Considering the depiction in this robot vacuum app, can you tell me how much of the floor has already been cleaned, how much is still remains?

How much power is left on the vacuum itself? If that number is low, and based on the purple coloration of each room on that floor, is it reasonable for me to assume that it is largely or even completely done?
This is very helpful, because the app itself is not sufficiently accessible to me using VoiceOver on my iPhone as a blind user

The shark robot AI vacuum app has limited access accessibility, allowing me to choose the power level and initiate the cleaning process… But to learn the status at any time during the vacuuming, there's really no way to do it using voiceover, so this AI option is fantastic!
